translations.idev-page.hero.lede: Describe what you need in your own words. iCode writes the React code, runs it in front of you in the browser, and keeps changing it as you talk. The source code is yours to export.
translations.idev-page.targets.title: Three things it can build
translations.idev-page.steps.title: How a session goes
translations.idev-page.steps.body: There is no project setup, no repository to create and no build to configure. The first message is the first step.
translations.idev-page.preview.title: It runs while it is being written
translations.idev-page.preview.lede: The project runs in your browser — Node, the dev server and a real database, with nothing installed on your machine.
translations.idev-page.ship.title: Online in one move, or gone with you
translations.idev-page.ship.lede: « Put it online » hands the project to iDeploy and gives you an address — a static site or a full stack with its database, no GitHub account required. Or export the folder and host it wherever you like.
translations.idev-page.around.title: What comes before and after
translations.idev-page.around.body: iCode writes the application. The rest of the business — the brand, the plan, the address, the hosting — is the rest of IDEM.
translations.idev-page.target.site.title: A showcase site
translations.idev-page.target.site.description: Pages that present your business and bring in enquiries. Built from your brand if you already made one with IDEM.
translations.idev-page.target.web.title: A web application
translations.idev-page.target.web.description: Accounts, forms, a database, pages that do work. The kind of tool you would otherwise run on a spreadsheet.
translations.idev-page.target.mobile.title: A phone application
translations.idev-page.target.mobile.description: Laid out for a phone, installable straight from its link, and packaged for Android and iOS from the same code.
translations.idev-page.step.describe.title: Say what you need
translations.idev-page.step.describe.description: Plain sentences, in French or English. « A booking page for my salon, with the opening hours and a deposit » is enough to start.
translations.idev-page.step.build.title: Watch it get written
translations.idev-page.step.build.description: Files appear one after another and the preview reloads as they land. You can read every line while it happens.
translations.idev-page.step.adjust.title: Change it by talking
translations.idev-page.step.adjust.description: « Move the price above the photo », « add a second language ». No file to find, no code to edit by hand unless you want to.
translations.idev-page.step.ship.title: Put it online
translations.idev-page.step.ship.description: One button hands the project to iDeploy and returns a working address with HTTPS. Or export the source and host it yourself.
translations.idev-page.preview.container.title: Node runs in the tab
translations.idev-page.preview.container.description: The dev server starts inside your browser. Nothing to install, and the preview is the real project rather than a picture of it.
translations.idev-page.preview.database.title: A real database in the preview
translations.idev-page.preview.database.description: Postgres runs alongside the app, so sign-up, saved records and queries work before anything is deployed.
translations.idev-page.preview.fullstack.title: Front and back together
translations.idev-page.preview.fullstack.description: A full-stack project runs its interface and its API side by side, the way it will run in production.
translations.idev-page.preview.errors.title: Errors come with a fix
translations.idev-page.preview.errors.description: When the build or the page breaks, the error is shown with a « Fix » button that hands it back to the model with the stack trace.
translations.idev-page.preview.phone.title: A phone frame for phone apps
translations.idev-page.preview.phone.description: Mobile projects preview inside an iPhone and an Android mockup, because a phone layout cannot be judged in a desktop window.
translations.idev-page.preview.code.title: The code is not hidden
translations.idev-page.preview.code.description: Open the editor, read any file, edit it directly. The conversation and the editor work on the same project.
translations.idev-page.ecosystem.idem.name: The IDEM platform
translations.idev-page.ecosystem.idem.description: Brand, business plan, finances, legal papers and communication — everything the application is the front of.
translations.idev-page.ecosystem.ideploy.description: Hosting, domain name, certificates and logs, on our machines or on yours.
